_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY -- copy to .agent/provider_keys.json (gitignored) and paste real keys. llm_generate._load_key_pool reads this: each provider maps to an ORDERED list of keys, rotated on 402/403/429/401 so a spent key is skipped and the sweep never stalls on one account. Provider names must match _PROVIDER_REGISTRY: openrouter, groq, cerebras, together, sambanova, featherless, mistral (nvidia uses NVIDIA_API_KEY from .env). Verified live 2026-07-09: nvidia + sambanova + ollama-cloud complete chat; groq/cerebras/together keys 403 on chat (account-level), openrouter 402 no-credit. Env vars <PREFIX>_API_KEY and <PREFIX>_API_KEY_2..N are also read as pool members.
